results.generated_reply_en:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Heidi from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today.

I completely understand your concern about your dog's safety—we will do our best to help you find the right setup. All TOPENS products are backed by a 12-month warranty.

Running through your questions for your two lightweight gates (under 100lb each with wheels) in Minnesota using solar:

1. Between the AD5S and AT6132S, the AD5S is a more suitable match. It is designed for lighter residential gates, whereas the AT6132S features heavier-duty rams that are not necessary for gates under 100lb and wheels.

2. Yes, both models have an auto-close feature. You can set the timer on the control board so the gates close automatically after someone drives through.

3. The compatible weatherproof wired keypad is the TOPENS KPW-1000. You will need to wire it directly to the control board.

4. A key consideration for your Minnesota setup is winter performance. For reliable solar operation of the AD5S, especially when adding power-consuming accessories like the keypad and considering the reduced sunlight hours in winter, it is strongly recommended to upgrade the batteries to a higher capacity (such as 12Ah or 17Ah deep cycle AGM/GEL) and use a 30W solar panel to compensate for the keypad's standby power consumption.

5. The system is powered by a single, central control box that houses the battery and control board. Both actuator arms are then connected to this single control box via their cables, which draws power from the central battery.

6. Yes, you can absolutely leave the wheels on the gates. The arms are strong enough to push the gates, and the wheels will help reduce the load on the hinges and the opener over time.

7. In an emergency, you can manually open the gates by disengaging the clutch mechanism with the included key. This disconnects the arm from the motor, allowing you to push the gate freely.

8. You can purchase either directly or on Amazon, but buying from TOPENS directly allows us to register your warranty immediately and provide faster direct service.

To give you the most specific advice for your installation, could you please send us photos of your gate and post area when you have a moment?

Thank you once again for being a valued customer! Your complete satisfaction is what we strive for. We at TOPENS are always standing by and ready to help.

Best regards,
Heidi
TOPENS Customer Service Team

I am sorry to hear that your TC148 gate opener has stopped working. Do not worry, we will do our best to help you. All TOPENS products are backed by a 12-month warranty, and we will assist you in resolving this issue or arranging a replacement if needed.

Checked with our engineer, please help us do some tests to find out the problem, so that we can provide corresponding help.

1. Disconnect the extension cable connecting the TC148 push button to the control board, and test it with a short cable to see if the gate opener works. If it works with the short cable, please confirm the distance between the TC148 and the control board.

2. Disconnect all wired accessories from the control board except the power supply and the arm. Then, momentarily short the push button terminals (O/S/C and COM) by briefly touching a wire between them — just plug in and pull out instantly. Let me know if the opener responds to this instant short.

3. Kindly confirm if the wall switch is a genuine TOPENS TC148. Please note that third-party switches may be incompatible and can cause the system to stop responding.

4. Please check the wire distance and gauge between the push button and the control board. We recommend using well-shielded 2C×22 AWG (2×0.3 mm²) minimum wire, and keeping the cable length under 15 meters whenever possible.

Please let me know the result one by one. Also, if possible, please send me a clear video or photos of the control board wiring so I can check the connections for you. 

To proceed with the warranty, could you please provide me with your order number, shipping address with zip code, and a contact phone number? Please note a street address is required, not a PO Box.

results.generated_reply_en:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Joyce from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today.

I apologize for the inconvenience this intermittent issue is causing. That kind of unpredictable behavior can be frustrating, but do not worry, we will work through this together. All TOPENS products are backed by a 12-month warranty, so we'll make sure you get the right support.

Checked with our engineer, please help us do some tests to find out the problem, so that we can provide corresponding help.

1. Check if the blue light on the remote lights up when a button is pressed. If not, replace the two CR2025 batteries and try again. Next, erase the remote codes and reprogram the remote following the instructions in the user manual. Then test whether the remote operates the gate opener.

2. Try moving the remote closer to the gate opener. If that helps, adjust the antenna on the control board—experiment with its position, angle, and direction to improve the signal.

3. Use a jumper wire to momentarily short the push button terminals on the control board (briefly touch and remove the wire), and observe whether the gate opener responds. Repeat the test several times to check if it triggers reliably each time. If it does, the gate opener system should be fine, so please check the surrounding area for sources of signal interference like high-voltage power lines, large transformers, metal fences, telecom base stations, or radio towers. If the gate opener cannot respond correctly from this test, please continue to step 4.

4. Disengage the clutch and manually check whether the gate moves smoothly. If it is not so smooth, please check the gate and installation, and lubricate the arm if necessary. Then keep the clutch disengaged and press the remote—observe whether the gate opener responds each time. If it does, the motor and control board are likely fine, and the problem is extra mechanical resistance—please inspect the gate and installation again. If the motor still cannot respond properly, the control board or the motor may be defective. You can then disconnect the RED & BLACK wires of the arm from the control board and connect them directly to a 24V DC power source—the motor should run. Exchange the polarity of the wires, and the arm should run in the opposite direction. If the motor runs properly in both directions, the motor is good and the control board is likely the cause.

Please let me know the result one by one.

Videos showing the problem and pictures of the whole control board are much appreciated for further judgement. You can directly send the video to my E-mail via the attachment. If the sending is not successful, please share the photo or video link through dropbox, icloud or google drive. Thanks for your understanding and cooperation.

And also please reply your specific SHIPPING ADDRESS with zip code and confirm PHONE # available for further assistance.

Thank you again for being a valued customer! Your complete satisfaction is what we strive for. We at TOPENS are always standing by and ready to help.

Best regards,
Joyce
TOPENS Customer Service Team
